title: Membership
wikitext:
There are several kinds of '''Membership''' cards among the [[Special]] cards.  

The Membership cards all entitle the investigator to have a special type of encounter in some location, and may require them to have it in place of the usual encounter at that location.

== List of Membership Cards ==

* [["One of the Thousand" Cult Membership]] entitles and requires the investigator to have a [[Cult Encounter]] in place of the standard encounter at the [[Black Cave]], the [[Unvisited Isle]], or the [[Woods]] in [[Arkham]].
* [[Sheldon Gang Membership]] gives the investigator the option of a random encounter when ending the turn in a [[street]] location.
* [[Silver Twilight Lodge Membership]] requires the investigator to have an encounter at the [[Inner Sanctum]] in place of an encounter at the [[Silver Twilight Lodge]]
